sourceStatus: 95 official-source scene versions, community-organized; EA original hashes not independently confirmed
evidenceLimits: Counts include Road trim/marking/sidewalk layers; they are not counts of main carriageways.
Geometry and endpoint pairs are mathematical candidates, not native/game seam certification.
Object Z is ground-relative. Missing alignToTerrain is property-absent, not false.
No Invisible material observed in this collection; not proof of absence in all versions/MODs.
